metadata.description: Seedream 5.0 Pro is grounded, region-precise image editing model that changes one element while keeping the rest of the frame intact with layer separation, sketch completion, and up to 10 reference images.

info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/seedream-5-pro/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/seedream-5-pro/edit queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit images using Bytedance's Seedream 5.0 Pro model.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

examples: Replace the product in Figure 1 with that in Figure 2. Seamlessly render the logo in Figure 3 into the product design, in a frosted glass texture.
prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The text prompt used to edit the image.

image_urls.description: List of URLs of input reference images. Up to 10 images are supported; if more are sent, only the last 10 are used.
image_urls.title: Image URLs

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Total pixels must be between 1024x1024 and 2048x2048, with aspect ratio between 1/16 and 16.
image_size.title: Image Size

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The file format of the generated image.

num_images.description: Number of separate model generations to run with the prompt.
num_images.title: Num Images

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
